# @arki/native-ui

> React Native UI components for ARKI: React Native Reusables styled with NativeWind on rn-primitives, plus small helpers.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): install, quick start, public imports and helpers.

## By task
- Use a component: import it from `@arki/native-ui/components/<name>` (button, card, dialog, tabs and more).
- Merge class names: `@arki/native-ui/lib/cn`.
- Colors and checks: `@arki/native-ui/lib/colors` (`isValidHexColor`) and `@arki/native-ui/lib/utils`.

## Rules that bite
- Native only. For the web use `@arki/ui`.
- NativeWind is required. Components style themselves with `className`. The package defines no theme, dark mode comes from your Tailwind setup.
- `Icon` wraps Phosphor React Native. Pass the icon with the `as` prop.
- It ships compiled code. To edit a component, copy it from React Native Reusables.
